channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US officials push back on reports of dangerously low munitions supplies
item.description: Experts warn that low stockpiles of air defence interceptors as a result of the war on Iran leave the US vulnerable.

item.title: Iran says Hormuz talks with Oman in ‘final’ stages as route approved
item.description: The geographical coordinates of the route in the waterway have been agreed upon with Oman, according to Tehran.

item.title: US authorities say three killed in Prospect Hill, North Carolina shooting
item.description: Law enforcement says at least three people were killed in shooting at a home, with those involved part of same family.

item.title: At least one Lebanese person, two Israeli soldiers killed in south Lebanon
item.description: The violence comes amid talks between Lebanon and Israel as Beirut pushes for a phased Israeli troop withdrawal.

item.title: Russia kills 17 in ballistic missile attacks around Kyiv
item.description: At least 17 people were killed after Russia launched an overnight ballistic missile and drone attack on Kyiv.

item.title: Iran says it has agreed Strait of Hormuz shipping route with Oman
item.description: A foreign ministry spokesman did not give details but said an agreement with the Gulf nation was "in the final stages".

item.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after first evacuation warning in weeks
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says one person was killed in the strikes, which the Israeli military says were a response to a Hezbollah ceasefire violation.

item.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
item.description: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

item.title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
item.description: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.

item.title: The avalanche that killed a climbing legend - and a generation of record-setting guides
item.description: Their fellow guides say their deaths in Pakistan dealt a devastating blow to Nepal's mountaineering community.
